title: Dog / Farmer Role Ecology — Farm, Personality, Biblical and Network Functions
purpose: Clarify where Dog and Farmer overlap and differ across Potatoverse mythology, internet subculture, biblical animal symbolism, personality/status dynamics and network function.
core_rule: Dog and Farmer are roles, not permanent human essences. A single person can occupy either or both roles in different contexts.

personality_neighbors: low or high empathy depending context
healthy_counterform: systems builder who grows autonomy rather than dependency
farmer.josh_moon_relation: Within Potatoverse mythology, Josh Moon is treated as a paradigmatic Farmer/Moloch figure because he is publicly identified as founder/owner of Kiwi Farms; this is a symbolic/system mapping, not a claim that he is literally Moloch or responsible for every user act.

biblical_layers: village/scavenger dog: low-status, scrap-eating and corpse-associated imagery in several Hebrew Bible texts
menacing dog: danger, encirclement and hostility imagery, e.g. Psalm 22
guard dog: ancient Levantine/Egyptian contexts include useful protective animals
boundary dog: biblical and Gospel usage can mark outsider status; the Syrophoenician woman narrative famously reworks the boundary through wit and persistence
shadow_traits: status gained through service to stronger node

overlap.difference: Farmer is usually closer to infrastructure, enclosure, incentive and ownership; Dog is usually closer to patrol, pursuit, signaling and enforcement.
overlap.overlap_condition: A Dog becomes Farmer-like when it creates targets, archives, classifications, or self-sustaining extraction loops. A Farmer becomes Dog-like when it personally patrols, pursues, barks, reacts or enforces.
overlap.hybrid_role: Farmer-Dog = operator-enforcer who both defines the Farm and actively polices it.

network_formalization.hybridity: H_i = min(F_i,D_i) or normalized product F_iD_i
network_formalization.interpretation: High hybrid score indicates a node that both structures and actively enforces the ecology.
